question: Can close-confirmed and temporally ordered contractions distinguish a persistent VCP path from intrabar oscillation, broad recovery and abrupt repricing?
universe: All SH/SZ daily securities passing the existing causal stage-two trend and RS>=85 context on each completed day from 2018 through 2025. The broad VCP detector and all previous v3 representations are not inputs.

fixed_representation.pivot: The highest completed close in the 120 bars before the signal, at least 10 bars old.
fixed_representation.prior_advance: The pivot close must be at least 30 percent above the preceding 63-bar closing low, and the rise must span at least 20 completed bars.
fixed_representation.close_confirmed_turns: Directional changes are detected only from completed closes using the larger of 3 percent or twice the median absolute daily close return, capped at 12 percent. A recovery must occur strictly after its trough and a following peak must occur strictly after that recovery.
fixed_representation.persistent_legs: Each decline and recovery must span at least three completed sessions, and no single close-to-close move may contribute more than half of that leg's absolute close-path movement.
fixed_representation.contraction: At least two completed decline-recovery waves are required. The latest decline must be shallower and have lower mean volume on declining closes than its predecessor.
fixed_representation.right_edge: The final pre-signal close must be above the midpoint of the latest decline and the range of the final ten completed closes must be smaller than the latest decline depth.
fixed_representation.demand: The signal must be the first close above the pivot, close in the upper half of its daily range, and trade more volume than the preceding 20-bar median.
fixed_representation.causality: All state transitions use completed bars through the signal close. Any execution would occur no earlier than the next valid market open.

fresh_blind_packet.exclusions: All identities used by the four earlier semantic packets are excluded.
fresh_blind_packet.selection: Ascending SHA-256 within year and sealed status; future outcomes are neither computed nor used.

stop_rule: If the packet cannot be formed or any semantic gate fails, stop price-path representation work without changing lookbacks, reversal size, persistence rules, wave count, right-edge rule or trend context on exposed samples.
next_if_pass: Register the frozen detector as a separate matrix-native v3 strategy and run one fixed development and diagnostic time split.
next_if_fail: Stop geometric price-path refinement. Keep forward-v2 frozen and select one new pre-signal causal fact rather than another price threshold.
